tips.title: Cloudflare's Clef: the open-weight decision model
tips.summary: Cloudflare released Clef (27B) and Clef-flash (9B), its first in-house-trained models: open-weight (Apache 2.0) "decision models" that return per-option probabilities instead of generating text, aimed at the hot path of agentic workflows — routing, triage, escalation. The HN thread (626 pts, 217 comments) was split between awe at the speed of commoditization and skepticism: "open weights, not open source," and real-user tests showing Clef slower than Jev in production, contradicting vendor latency claims.
